Get your permit if you carry or not.

1) It helps keep the permit alive. The more people to get it makes it easier to justify things like national carry or keeping it around. And 2) even if you don't carry it makes transportation so much easier. You dont need to try and be super careful like keeping it unloaded in your trunk when you go shooting. You COULD conceivably keep it loaded in your pocket. Not saying anyone would, but you could just have it unloaded in its case in the seat next to you. No thought has to go into "how it may look" or "am I allowed to do this". As long as it's safe it's pretty much kosher with a ccw. Also there's 3) if you ever decide to take shooting classes some might require a ccw as a pre-requisite. You'd already have one.
